item.title: Chiefs quarterback Patrick Mahomes to get second opinion on torn ACL before having surgery
item.description: Patrick Mahomes will get a second opinion on his torn left ACL before having surgery, Chiefs coach Andy Reid said Monday, and it remains unclear whether the two-time MVP quarterback could be available by the start of next season.
